cases.source:
claim:
    ? forall a,x,y R+:
        a>1
        x<y
        =>:
            log(a,x)<log(a,y)
    a!=1
    ln(a)>0
    ln(x)<ln(y)
    log(a,x)=ln(x)/ln(a)<ln(y)/ln(a)=log(a,y)
